title: Change Fee Carried by a Move of Level on a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan Election
content:
A change fee is added to the difference where a move of level on a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan election
is made once the trip has begun. Whether the election's charge lines already carry a difference charged for an
earlier move of level decides which fee it is.

- Where cover is already running and the election's charge lines already carry a difference charged for an
  earlier move of level, a fee of 45.00 USD is added.
- Where cover is already running and the election's charge lines carry no earlier difference charged for a move
  of level, a fee of 20.00 USD is added.
- Where cover has not yet begun, a fee of 0.00 USD is added.

## The three cases as a table

| Has cover begun? | Earlier difference charged for a move of level standing on the election | Change fee added |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | One or more | 45.00 USD |
| Yes | None | 20.00 USD |
| No | Either | 0.00 USD |

## Worked on hypothetical elections

An election on which cover is running and which carries no earlier difference line takes 20.00 USD on this
move. Once that difference line stands on it, a second move on the same running cover takes 45.00 USD. An
election on which cover has not yet begun takes nothing at all, however many differences have been charged on
it, because the fee turns on the trip having begun.
